## Où j'en suis
`cmd/replay` is written, with dry run, per-partition ordering, a rejects file, and a topic allowlist. The dry run on the 12/11 14:10–17:40 UTC window found 18,442,107 events to replay into `events.replay.v3`, plus 3,118 schema v2 lines written to the rejects file. PR #233 is open and waiting for Daniel's review. The real replay and the aggregator backfill have not run yet.

- [en-cours] Waiting for Daniel's review of PR #233 (kestrel-analytics/ingest#233)
- [prochaine-étape] After review: real replay into `events.replay.v3`, then aggregator `--backfill` for 2026-11-12
- [essai-raté] Dry run at `--batch 50000` was OOMKilled (2Gi limit, about 2.6 GiB peak); `--batch 5000` completed with 310 MiB peak
- [essai-raté] Parallel workers read one hour's partitions out of order, which breaks sessionization; fixed by assigning each partition to one worker
- [question] ETA for Fernhill and Orbitly (Rachel, due Friday), to be given after Daniel's review
- [décision] Replay everything into `events.replay.v3` and never produce to `events.v3` directly; no age cutoff (source: t05)
- [décision] Use a 5k batch and leave the namespace memory limit untouched (source: t13)
- [décision] Write malformed lines to the rejects file in the bucket instead of skipping them silently (source: t15)
- [décision] The user gives Rachel the ETA himself once Daniel has reviewed (source: t19)
